meaning:
Ἄννας, -α (FlJ, Ἄνανος, -ου), ὁ (Heb. חָנַן),
Annas, the high priest: Luk.3:2, Jhn.18:13-24, Act.4:6.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: in the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.
and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.
